2. This writ petition has been filed by
the petitioner seeking a direction to
respondent no.2 not to transfer him from
Sub-Jail, Haldwani to any other jail.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the petitioner is suffering
from Dilated Cardiomyopathy and is
undergoing continuous medical treatment
at AIIMS, New Delhi as well as Dr.
Susheela Tiwari Government Hospital,
Haldwani. It is submitted that the
petitioner is required to be taken to the
aforesaid hospitals for regular medical
treatment and follow-up. Learned counsel
submits that, in the event the petitioner is
transferred from Sub-Jail, Haldwani to
any other jail, his continued medical
treatment may be adversely affected and
his life and liberty may be put to serious
risk.
4. Learned State Counsel, on

UKHC010173802026
2026:UHC:9017
instructions, submits that, as per the
policy of the Jail Authorities, a convict
sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a
period of more than seven years is
ordinarily transferred from Sub-Jail,
Haldwani to Sampurnanand Shivir,
Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar.
However, convicts requiring regular
medical treatment and suffering from
serious ailments are permitted to remain
at Sub-Jail, Haldwani, having regard to
their medical condition. He further
submits that, as on date, no order has
been passed transferring the petitioner
from Sub-Jail, Haldwani to
Sampurnanand Shivir, Sitarganj, District
Udham Singh Nagar.
5. In view of the statement made by
learned State Counsel, no cause of action
has arisen to the petitioner at this stage.
The writ petition is, accordingly,
premature and is dismissed as such.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 06.10.2026
Arpan
